title: Wong--Zakai Convergence and FNO Learning for Stochastic Volterra Equations
abstract: arXiv:2610.18939v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper studies Wong--Zakai convergence and Fourier neural operator learning for stochastic Volterra integral equations (SVIEs) describing random systems with memory. A Wong--Zakai theorem establishes convergence of pathwise solutions driven by piecewise linear approximations of Brownian motion to the corresponding SVIE solution. This convergence provides a foundation for using mirror-padded Fourier neural operators to learn the solution operator mapping initial conditions and driving noise to entire solution trajectories. Numerical experiments demonstrate competitive prediction accuracy and generalization to temporal grids finer than those used for training, while assessing the influence of padding and computational cost. As a follow-up to \citet{LKP:26}, this study extends their operator-learning framework to SVIEs through separate convergence and approximation analyses tailored to convolutional memory.

translated_title: 随机Volterra方程的Wong–Zakai收敛性与傅里叶神经算子学习
translated_abstract: 本文研究了描述具有记忆效应的随机系统的随机Volterra积分方程（SVIE）的Wong–Zakai收敛性与傅里叶神经算子学习。文中证明了一个Wong–Zakai定理，建立了由布朗运动的分段线性逼近所驱动的逐路径解向相应SVIE解的收敛性。该收敛性为使用镜像填充傅里叶神经算子来学习解算子奠定了基础，该解算子将初始条件和驱动噪声映射到完整的解轨迹。数值实验展示了具有竞争力的预测精度，以及向比训练所用时间网格更细的网格的泛化能力，同时评估了填充方式和计算成本的影响。作为对\citet{LKP:26}的后续研究，本研究通过对卷积记忆特性量身定制的独立收敛性分析与逼近性分析，将其算子学习框架扩展到了SVIE。
tldr: 本文为随机Volterra积分方程建立了Wong–Zakai收敛定理，并在此基础上证明镜像填充傅里叶神经算子能够学习其解算子，实现对完整解轨迹的准确预测以及向更细时间网格的泛化。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a Wong–Zakai convergence theorem for stochastic Volterra integral equations and, building upon it, demonstrates that mirror-padded Fourier neural operators can learn the solution operator, achieving accurate prediction of full solution trajectories and generalization to finer temporal grids.
